---
title: "Measurement weirdo"
format: html
---

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
triggerR <- new.env()
source("R/read_data.R", local = triggerR)
if (!exists("trigger_tidy")) trigger_tidy <- triggerR$read_trigger_table("myair_tidy")
```

## PM / PC extreme values

```{r}
pm <- c("pm1", "pm25", "pm10")
pc <- c("pc03", "pc05", "pc1", "pc25", "pc5", "pc10")

pm_wide <- trigger_tidy %>%
  select(userId, minute_ts, starts_with(c("pm", "pc"))) 

pm_long <- pm_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with(c("pm", "pc")), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")
```

```{r}
pm_summary <- pm_long %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(value)),
    missing_pct = mean(is.na(value)) * 100,
    q25 = quantile(value, .25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q50 = quantile(value, .50, na.rm = TRUE),
    q95 = quantile(value, .95, na.rm = TRUE),
    q99 = quantile(value, .99, na.rm = TRUE),
    q999 = quantile(value, .999, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
pm_summary
```


```{r}
pm_table <- pm_summary %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(q25, q50, q95, q99, q999, max),
      ~ formatC(.x, format = "f", digits = 1)
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(variable, n, missing_pct),
    names_to = "Statistic",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

pm_table_plot <- pm_table %>%
  filter(Statistic %in% c("q25", "q50", "q95", "q99", "max")) %>%
  mutate(
    Statistic = factor(
      Statistic,
      levels = c("q25", "q50", "q95", "q99", "max"),
      labels = c("P25", "Median", "P95", "P99", "Maximum")
    ),
    variable = factor(variable, levels = rev(unique(variable)))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(Statistic, variable)) +
  geom_tile(fill = "white", colour = "grey75") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Value), size = 3) +
  labs(title = "PM / PC distribution summary") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

pm_table_plot

ggsave(
  "~/pm_pc_distribution_summary.png",
  pm_table_plot,
  width = 4,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
pm_wide <- pm_wide %>%
  mutate(
    bad_pm = pm1 > pm25 | pm25 > pm10 | pm1 > pm10,
    bad_pc = pc03 < pc05 | pc05 < pc1 | pc1 < pc25 | pc25 < pc5 | pc5 < pc10,
    extreme = if_any(all_of(c(pm, pc)), ~ .x >= 60000),
    suspect = coalesce(bad_pm, FALSE) |
      coalesce(bad_pc, FALSE) |
      coalesce(extreme, FALSE)
  )

episodes <- pm_wide %>%
  filter(suspect) %>%
  group_by(userId) %>%
  arrange(minute_ts, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    gap = as.numeric(difftime(minute_ts, lag(minute_ts), units = "mins")),
    episode = cumsum(is.na(gap) | gap != 1)
  ) %>%
  group_by(userId, episode) %>%
  summarise(
    start = min(minute_ts),
    end = max(minute_ts),
    buckets = n(),
    extreme = sum(extreme, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(extreme), desc(buckets)) %>%
  mutate(id = row_number(), .before = 1)

episodes %>%
  select(-userId, -episode)
```


```{r}
event <- episodes %>% filter(id == 2)

view <- pm_wide %>%
  filter(
    userId == event$userId,
    minute_ts >= event$start - lubridate::hours(1),
    minute_ts <= event$end + lubridate::hours(1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(minute_ts) %>%
  mutate(
    segment = cumsum(c(TRUE, diff(as.numeric(minute_ts)) != 60))
  ) %>%
  select(minute_ts, segment, suspect, all_of(c(pm, pc))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(c(pm, pc)),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = c(pm, pc)))

p_event <- ggplot(view, aes(minute_ts, value)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = segment), linewidth = 0.3, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = suspect), size = 1, na.rm = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey50", "TRUE" = "#D73027")) +
  labs(
    x = "Time (UTC)",
    y = "One-minute measurement",
    colour = "Flagged row"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=12}
p_event
```


```{r}
if (!exists("smartlow_tidy")) smartlow_tidy <- triggerR$read_trigger_table("smartwatchlow_tidy")
```


```{r}
temp <- smartlow_tidy %>%
  select(userId, minute_ts, bodytemp, skintemp) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c("userId", "minute_ts"), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(userId, variable) %>%
  mutate(bucket_1min = n_distinct(minute_ts)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
p_temp <- temp %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value, fill = variable)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  facet_wrap(~variable) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```


```{r, fig.width=28, fig.height=8}
temp %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = userId, y = value, fill = bucket_1min)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.33, outlier.alpha = 0.33, alpha = 0.75) +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "sqrt", name = "Observed buckets") +
  labs(x = "Participant", y = "One-minute value") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 16)) 
```
